audit.root_cause: env.py builds RetryConfig(include=[...]), a field that existed in the verifiers 0.3.x v1 API but was replaced by `rules` in verifiers 0.4.0 (the latest PyPI release), and the package declares no verifiers dependency, so a fresh install gets 0.4.0 and fails at import.
audit.evidence: src/econarena_eval/env.py:78-80 `RetryConfig(max_retries=2, include=["ProviderError","HarnessError"])`; pyproject.toml `dependencies = []` (comment: 'no verifiers dependency on purpose'); result.json import error on verifiers 0.4.0: 'include  Extra inputs are not permitted [type=extra_forbidden]'; v0.3.1 verifiers/v1/configs/retries.py has `include: list[str]`, main has only `max_retries` + `rules: list[RetryRule]`.
audit.irl_fix: Pin `verifiers>=0.3.1,<0.4`, or migrate to `RetryConfig(rules=[RetryRule(type='ProviderError', max_retries=2), RetryRule(type='HarnessError', max_retries=2)])`.
